SELECT
COUNT(*) AS PRODUCT_COUNT, SUM(COMBINE_TB.PRODUCT_COUNT) AS STOCK_COUNT
COMBINE_TB.PRODUCT_NAME, COMBINE_TB.QUANTITY, COMBINE_TB.PRICE
FROM ( -- 매칭코드 없음 SELECT '인터파크' AS SHOP_LIST, 1 AS SHOP_TYPE, '인터파크' AS SHOP, '인터파크-GOODS-NONE-MATCH' AS DIVISION, CIG.SHOP_ID, '-' AS MATCHING_CODE, CIG.PRODUCT_NM AS PRODUCT_NAME, '-' AS OPTION_NAME, CIG.STOCK_QUANTITY AS PRODUCT_COUNT, CIG.SELL_PRICE AS PRICE, CIG.STOCK_QUANTITY AS QUANTITY, 1 AS MATCHING_COUNT FROM CBCI_INTERPARK_GOODS CIG WHERE CIG.SHOP_ID REGEXP (#{INTERPARK_ID}) AND CIG.CUBICI_CODE IS NOT NULL AND CIG.MATCHING_CODE IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT '인터파크' AS SHOP_LIST, 1 AS SHOP_TYPE, '인터파크' AS SHOP, '인터파크-STOCK-NONE-MATCH' AS DIVISION, CIS.SHOP_ID, '-' AS MATCHING_CODE, CIG.PRODUCT_NM AS PRODUCT_NAME, CONCAT(CIS.OPTION1, ' > ', CIS.OPTION2) AS OPTION_NAME, CIS.OPTION_QUANTITY AS PRODUCT_COUNT, 1 AS PRICE, CIS.OPTION_QUANTITY AS QUANTITY, 1 AS MATCHING_COUNT FROM CBCI_INTERPARK_STOCK CIS LEFT JOIN CBCI_INTERPARK_GOODS CIG ON CIS.SHOP_ID = CIG.SHOP_ID AND CIS.PRODUCT_NO = CIG.PRODUCT_NO WHERE CIS.SHOP_ID REGEXP (#{INTERPARK_ID}) AND CIS.MATCHING_CODE IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT '옥션' AS SHOP_LIST, 3 AS SHOP_TYPE, '옥션' AS SHOP, '옥션-GOODS-NONE-MATCH' AS DIVISION, CAG.SHOP_ID, '-' AS MATCHING_CODE, CAG.ITEM_NAME AS PRODUCT_NAME, '-' AS OPTION_NAME, CAG.SUM_STOCK_QTY AS PRODUCT_COUNT, CAG.SELLING_PRICE AS PRICE, CAG.SUM_STOCK_QTY AS QUANTITY, 1 AS MATCHING_COUNT FROM CBCI_AUCTION_GOODS CAG WHERE CAG.SHOP_ID REGEXP (#{AUCTION_ID}) AND CAG.CUBICI_CODE IS NOT NULL AND CAG.MATCHING_CODE IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT '11번가' AS SHOP_LIST, 4 AS SHOP_TYPE, '11번가' AS SHOP, '11번가-GOODS-MATCH' AS DIVISION, CSG.SHOP_ID, CSG.MATCHING_CODE, CSG.PRD_NM AS PRODUCT_NAME, '-' AS OPTION_NAME, CSG.QUANTITY AS PRODUCT_COUNT, CSG.SEL_PRC AS PRICE, CSG.QUANTITY, 1 AS MATCHING_COUNT FROM CBCI_11ST_GOODS CSG WHERE CSG.SHOP_ID REGEXP (#{ELEVEN_ID}) AND CSG.CUBICI_CODE IS NOT NULL AND CSG.MATCHING_CODE IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT '쿠팡' AS SHOP_LIST, 11 AS SHOP_TYPE, '쿠팡' AS SHOP, '쿠팡-NONE-MATCH' AS DIVISION, CCS.SHOP_ID, '-' AS MATCHING_CODE, CCG.SELLER_PRODUCT_NM AS PRODUCT_NAME, CCS.ITEM_NAME AS OPTION_NAME, CCS.OPT_AMOUNT_IN_STOCK AS PRODUCT_COUNT, CCS.SALE_PRICE AS PRICE, CCS.OPT_AMOUNT_IN_STOCK AS QUANTITY, 1 AS MATCHING_COUNT FROM CBCI_COUPANG_STOCK CCS LEFT JOIN CBCI_COUPANG_GOODS CCG ON CCS.SHOP_ID = CCG.SHOP_ID AND CCS.SELLER_PRODUCT_ID = CCG.SELLER_PRODUCT_ID WHERE CCS.SHOP_ID = #{COUPANG_ID} AND CCS.MATCHING_CODE IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT '네이버' AS SHOP_LIST, 14 AS SHOP_TYPE, '네이버' AS SHOP, '네이버-GOODS-NONE-MATCH' AS DIVISION, CNG.SHOP_ID, '-' AS MATCHING_CODE, CNG.PRODUCT_NM AS PRODUCT_NAME, '-' AS OPTION_NAME, CNG.STOCK_QUANTITY AS PRODUCT_COUNT, CNG.SELL_PRICE AS PRICE, CNG.STOCK_QUANTITY AS QUANTITY, 1 AS MATCHING_COUNT FROM CBCI_NAVER_GOODS CNG WHERE CNG.SHOP_ID REGEXP (#{NAVER_ID}) AND CNG.CUBICI_CODE IS NOT NULL AND CNG.MATCHING_CODE IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT '네이버' AS SHOP_LIST, 14 AS SHOP_TYPE, '네이버' AS SHOP, '네이버-STOCK-NONE-MATCH' AS DIVISION, CNS.SHOP_ID AS SHOP_ID, '-' AS MATCHING_CODE, CNG.PRODUCT_NM AS PRODUCT_NAME, CONCAT(CNS.OPTION_NM_1, ' > ', CNS.OPTION_NM_2, ' > ', CNS.OPTION_NM_3) AS OPTION_NAME, CNS.OPTION_QUANTITY AS PRODUCT_COUNT, -- 상품 재고 CNS.OPTION_PRICE AS PRICE, CNS.OPTION_QUANTITY AS QUANTITY, 1 AS MATCHING_COUNT -- 매칭되어있는 상품 수 FROM CBCI_NAVER_STOCK CNS LEFT JOIN CBCI_NAVER_GOODS CNG ON CNS.SHOP_ID = CNG.SHOP_ID AND CNS.PRODUCT_NO = CNG.PRODUCT_NO WHERE CNS.SHOP_ID REGEXP (#{NAVER_ID}) AND CNS.MATCHING_CODE IS NULL UNION ALL -- 매칭코드 있음 SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(MATCHING_TB.SHOP SEPARATOR ', ') AS SHOP_LIST, MATCHING_TB.*, SUM(MATCHING_TB.PRODUCT_COUNT) AS QUANTITY, COUNT(*) AS MATCHING_COUNT FROM ( SELECT 3 AS SHOP_TYPE, '옥션' AS SHOP, '옥션-GOODS-MATCH' AS DIVISION, CAG.SHOP_ID, CAG.MATCHING_CODE, CAG.ITEM_NAME AS PRODUCT_NAME, '-' AS OPTION_NAME, CAG.SUM_STOCK_QTY AS PRODUCT_COUNT, CAG.SELLING_PRICE AS PRICE FROM CBCI_AUCTION_GOODS CAG WHERE CAG.SHOP_ID REGEXP (#{AUCTION_ID}) AND CAG.CUBICI_CODE IS NOT NULL AND CAG.MATCHING_CODE IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT 4 AS SHOP_TYPE, '11번가' AS SHOP, '11번가-GOODS-MATCH' AS DIVISION, CSG.SHOP_ID, CSG.MATCHING_CODE, CSG.PRD_NM AS PRODUCT_NAME, '-' AS OPTION_NAME, CSG.QUANTITY AS PRODUCT_COUNT, CSG.SEL_PRC FROM CBCI_11ST_GOODS CSG WHERE CSG.SHOP_ID REGEXP (#{ELEVEN_ID}) AND CSG.CUBICI_CODE IS NOT NULL AND CSG.MATCHING_CODE IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT 11 AS SHOP_TYPE, '쿠팡' AS SHOP, '쿠팡-MATCH' AS DIVISION, CCS.SHOP_ID, CCS.MATCHING_CODE, CCG.SELLER_PRODUCT_NM AS PRODUCT_NAME, CCS.ITEM_NAME AS OPTION_NAME, CCS.OPT_AMOUNT_IN_STOCK AS PRODUCT_COUNT, CCS.SALE_PRICE AS PRICE FROM CBCI_COUPANG_STOCK CCS LEFT JOIN CBCI_COUPANG_GOODS CCG ON CCS.SHOP_ID = CCG.SHOP_ID AND CCS.SELLER_PRODUCT_ID = CCG.SELLER_PRODUCT_ID WHERE CCS.SHOP_ID = #{COUPANG_ID} AND CCS.MATCHING_CODE IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT 14 AS SHOP_TYPE, '네이버' AS SHOP, '네이버-GOODS-MATCH' AS DIVISION, CNG.SHOP_ID, CNG.MATCHING_CODE, CNG.PRODUCT_NM AS PRODUCT_NAME, '-' AS OPTION_NAME, CNG.STOCK_QUANTITY AS PRODUCT_COUNT, CNG.SELL_PRICE AS PRICE FROM CBCI_NAVER_GOODS CNG WHERE CNG.SHOP_ID REGEXP (#{NAVER_ID}) AND CNG.CUBICI_CODE IS NOT NULL AND CNG.MATCHING_CODE IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT 14 AS SHOP_TYPE, '네이버' AS SHOP, '네이버-STOCK-MATCH' AS DIVISION, CNS.SHOP_ID, CNS.MATCHING_CODE, CNG.PRODUCT_NM AS PRODUCT_NAME, CONCAT(CNS.OPTION_NM_1, ' > ', CNS.OPTION_NM_2, ' > ', CNS.OPTION_NM_3) AS OPTION_NAME, CNS.OPTION_QUANTITY AS PRODUCT_COUNT, CNS.OPTION_PRICE AS PRICE FROM CBCI_NAVER_STOCK CNS LEFT JOIN CBCI_NAVER_GOODS CNG ON CNS.SHOP_ID = CNG.SHOP_ID AND CNS.PRODUCT_NO = CNG.PRODUCT_NO WHERE CNS.SHOP_ID REGEXP (#{NAVER_ID}) AND CNS.MATCHING_CODE IS NOT NULL ) MATCHING_TB GROUP BY MATCHING_TB.MATCHING_CODE ) COMBINE_TB
ORDER BY (COMBINE_TB.QUANTITY * COMBINE_TB.PRICE) DESC, COMBINE_TB.PRODUCT_NAME
ORDER BY COMBINE_TB.QUANTITY DESC, COMBINE_TB.PRODUCT_NAME
LIMIT 10
